flavor_text: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

name: Not Dead After All
oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control, then create a Wicked Role token attached to it." (Enchanted creature gets +1/+1. When this token is put into a graveyard, each opponent loses 1 life.)

all_parts.name: Wicked // Cursed
all_parts.type_line: Token Enchantment — Aura Role // Token Enchantment — Aura Role

name: Eager Construct
oracle_text: When this creature enters, each player may scry 1. (To scry 1, look at the top card of your library, then you may put that card on the bottom.)
flavor_text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Wash Out
oracle_text: Return all permanents of the color of your choice to their owners' hands.
flavor_text:
"It's not the darkness I fear but dull and numbing shades of gray."
—Sydri, galvanic genius

name: Skilled Animator
oracle_text: When this creature enters, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5 for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield.

name: Glimmerdust Nap
oracle_text:
Enchant tapped creature
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
flavor_text: The dreams of giants are as long as time and as deep as the earth. Thus they are prized by the dream-harvesting fae.

name: Presumed Dead
oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it." (A suspected creature has menace and can't block.)
flavor_text: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."

name: Chandra's Defeat
oracle_text: Chandra's Defeat deals 5 damage to target red creature or red planeswalker. If that permanent is a Chandra planeswalker, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
flavor_text:
"Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Unhallowed Pact
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
flavor_text: Agreements with demons seldom end at the grave.

name: Price of Progress
oracle_text: Price of Progress deals damage to each player equal to twice the number of nonbasic lands that player controls.
flavor_text: Enthusiasm can be tempered in the furnace of the earth.

name: Resolute Archangel
oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, if your life total is less than your starting life total, it becomes equal to your starting life total.
flavor_text: Cut it down, bury it in snow, put it to the torch. The rose will still bloom again.

name: Lurking Skirge
oracle_text: When a creature is put into an opponent's graveyard from the battlefield, if this permanent is an enchantment, it becomes a 3/2 Phyrexian Imp creature with flying.
flavor_text: They never miss a funeral.

name: Loxodon Lifechanter
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you may have your life total become the total toughness of creatures you control.
{5}{W}: This creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.

name: Pull from Eternity
oracle_text: Put target face-up exiled card into its owner's graveyard.
flavor_text:
It is best to conquer dragons before they hatch.
—Femeref adage

name: White Ward
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has protection from white. This effect doesn't remove this Aura.

name: Silence
oracle_text: Your opponents can't cast spells this turn.
flavor_text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Akki Ember-Keeper
oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken modified creature you control dies, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
flavor_text: "Follow my lantern, little ones."

name: Steel Golem
oracle_text: You can't cast creature spells.
flavor_text:
"Once you create perfection, what else is there to make?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Beacon of Immortality
oracle_text: Double target player's life total. Shuffle Beacon of Immortality into its owner's library.
flavor_text: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

name: Kodama of the West Tree
oracle_text:
Reach
Modified creatures you control have trample. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

name: High Perfect Morcant
oracle_text:
Whenever High Perfect Morcant or another Elf you control enters, each opponent blights 1. (They each put a -1/-1 counter on a creature they control.)
Tap three untapped Elves you control: Proliferate. Activate only as a sorcery. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

name: Hunters' Feast
oracle_text: Any number of target players each gain 6 life.
flavor_text: Those who kill a jawspur rhino must prepare spells to lift the carcass—even a dozen hunters can't lift its bulk.

name: Unholy Indenture
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavor_text:
"Don't think of it as selling your soul. It's more like you're bequeathing it to me."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more Goblins you control attack, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Whenever another creature you control enters, General Kreat deals 1 damage to each opponent.
flavor_text: To cross swords with her is a shockingly bad idea.

name: Sanctimony
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent taps a Mountain for mana, you may gain 1 life.
flavor_text: "The peasants labor for my profit. I approve."

name: Scald
oracle_text: Whenever a player taps an Island for mana, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.
flavor_text:
"Shiv may be surrounded by water, but the mountains go far deeper."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey
